hunks.baseline: “I already told you. Because of the fatal accident last week……”
hunks.sol: “I already told you. Because of the fatal accident last week…”

hunks.baseline: “You think I don’t know that? What I’m saying is, why are you being so uptight with someone you know?”
hunks.sol: “You think I don’t know that? I’m asking why you’re being so uptight with someone you know.”

hunks.baseline: “It’s a safety-inspection period. If you’re short on personnel, I can’t exactly approve your entry.”
hunks.sol: “It’s a safety-inspection period. If you’re short on personnel, I can’t approve your entry.”

hunks.baseline: Any Gate where a fatal accident occurred was subjected to a week of safety inspections. In other words, they raised the required number or level of personnel to prevent another accident. But the young man in front of him was being completely unreasonable.
hunks.sol: Any Gate where a fatal accident occurred was subjected to a week of safety inspections. The required number or level of personnel was raised to prevent another accident. But the young man in front of him refused to listen.

hunks.baseline: “What is this!”
hunks.sol: “What is this?”

hunks.baseline: The official jumped at the white envelope the young man thrust out and glanced around in alarm. A new employee who had joined the office recently was staring at him with wide, round eyes.
hunks.sol: The official jumped at the white envelope the young man thrust toward him and glanced around in alarm. A recent hire was staring at him with wide eyes.

hunks.baseline: At the young man’s blatant remark, the middle-aged official’s face flushed red. It wasn’t as if this was anything new, but what kind of disgrace was this in front of a new employee?
hunks.sol: At the young man’s blatant remark, the middle-aged official’s face flushed red. It wasn’t as if this was anything new, but did he have to humiliate him in front of the new employee?

hunks.baseline: “So……how is your team composed at the moment?”
hunks.sol: “So… what’s your current team composition?”

hunks.baseline: And now they were talking about ten people. Just as the official was hesitating—
hunks.sol: And now they were talking about going in with ten people. Just as the official was hesitating—

hunks.baseline: The young man’s menacing face had somehow acquired a smile.
hunks.sol: The young man, who had been badgering him with a menacing scowl moments earlier, was now smiling.

hunks.baseline: “The numbers have to be roughly right anyway, don’t they?”
hunks.sol: “The numbers have to look roughly right anyway, don’t they?”

hunks.baseline: “Ah, yes. That works.”
hunks.sol: “Ah, yes. That would be good.”

hunks.baseline: “Then let’s take those guys along. Make it look good.”
hunks.sol: “Then let’s take those people with us. Keep up appearances.”

hunks.baseline: The official followed the young man’s finger and turned his head. Five men and women had just entered the management office.
hunks.sol: The official followed the young man’s finger. A group of five had just entered the management office.

hunks.baseline: *Two middle-aged men. Two young men. And……*
hunks.sol: *Two middle-aged men. Two young men. And…*

hunks.baseline: After quickly finishing his calculations, the official picked up the envelope.
hunks.sol: After quickly doing the math, the official picked up the envelope.

hunks.baseline: It was currently a safety-inspection period, which meant that quite a few Guilds were experiencing delays in entering Gates. He even explained that with our current numbers, we would either have to hire mercenaries or join up with another Guild.
hunks.sol: It was currently a safety-inspection period, which meant quite a few Guilds were facing delays in entering Gates. With our current numbers, we would either have to hire mercenaries or join forces with another Guild.

hunks.baseline: “You’re in luck. The people from Sangdong Guild are waiting, and they’re exactly five people short.”
hunks.sol: “You’re in luck. The people from Sangdong Guild are waiting, and they happen to be exactly five people short.”

hunks.baseline: “If we join them, how long will it take until we can enter the Gate?”
hunks.sol: “If we join them, how long will it take for us to enter the Gate?”

hunks.baseline: “We can process it immediately once you join.”
hunks.sol: “We can process your entry immediately.”

hunks.baseline: Just as Butler Kim, the Guild Master, signed the contract, an unexpected voice cut in.
hunks.sol: Just as Butler Kim, the Guild Master, signed the contract, a voice cut in.

hunks.baseline: “Nice to meet you. I’m Im Changsoo, the Team Leader from Sangdong Guild.”
hunks.sol: “Nice to meet you. I’m Im Changsoo, a Team Leader from Sangdong Guild.”

hunks.baseline: *Sangdong Guild was strong enough to justify it.*
hunks.sol: *Someone from Sangdong Guild had every reason to be confident.*

hunks.baseline: Sangdong Guild was one of the five leading mid-sized Guilds in the area around Bucheon, with more than twenty B-rank Hunters alone.
hunks.sol: Sangdong Guild was one of the five leading mid-sized Guilds in the Bucheon area, with more than twenty B-rank Hunters alone.

hunks.baseline: He looked to be in his late twenties at most, yet he was already a Team Leader. That wasn’t a position one could luck into over a game of cards.[^1]
hunks.sol: He looked to be in his late twenties at most, yet he was already a Team Leader. That wasn’t a position someone could win in a game of cards.[^1]

hunks.baseline: The Qi Sense I activated soon afterward changed my guess into certainty.
hunks.sol: The Qi Sense I activated a moment later turned my guess into certainty.

hunks.baseline: While I was tilting my head, Butler Kim greeted him.
hunks.sol: While I tilted my head, Butler Kim greeted him.

hunks.baseline: We called him Butler Kim, Uncle, Kim Hyung, and plenty of other things, and we knew he was only a figurehead Guild Master. But from an outsider’s perspective, it was obvious at a glance that he was the person in charge.
hunks.sol: We called him Butler Kim, Uncle, Kim Hyung, and plenty of other things, and we knew he was only a figurehead Guild Master. But to an outsider, he obviously looked like the man in charge.

hunks.baseline: “Ah, Peace Guild. I’ve heard the name quite a bit.”
hunks.sol: “Ah, Peace Guild. I’ve heard quite a lot about you.”

hunks.baseline: Im Kkeokjeong and Miss Song, who were standing beside him, whispered to each other.
hunks.sol: Im Kkeokjeong and Miss Song, who were standing nearby, whispered to each other.

hunks.baseline: “Raids? Have we done many?”
hunks.sol: “What about raids? Have we done many?”

hunks.baseline: “What are you talking about? We haven’t even started remodeling the Guild house. This is our first official raid.”
hunks.sol: “What are you talking about? We haven’t even started remodeling the Guild house yet. This is our first official raid.”

hunks.baseline: A B-rank Hunter could hear everything, no matter how quietly someone spoke. Im Changsoo’s head turned toward the two of them.
hunks.sol: A B-rank Hunter could hear everything, no matter how quietly someone spoke. Im Changsoo turned toward the two of them.

hunks.baseline: “And who are these people?”
hunks.sol: “And these people are?”

hunks.baseline: “They’re Guild members.”
hunks.sol: “They’re members of our Guild.”

hunks.baseline: His gaze passed over the two of them—briefly over Im Kkeokjeong, then lingering a little longer on Miss Song.
hunks.sol: His gaze passed over them—briefly over Im Kkeokjeong, then lingering a little longer on Miss Song.

hunks.baseline: “I see. I said something unnecessary, haha.”
hunks.sol: “I see. Looks like I put my foot in my mouth. Ha-ha.”

hunks.baseline: “In any case, it seems fate brought us together. Since we’re on the same team now, I look forward to working with you.”
hunks.sol: “In any case, this must be fate. Since we’re on the same team now, I look forward to working with you.”

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi watched Im Changsoo’s back as he walked away, his gleaming chainmail clanking with every step. His face was serious.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi watched Im Changsoo walk away, his gleaming chainmail clanking with every step. His expression was grave.

hunks.baseline: “That man……”
hunks.sol: “That man…”

hunks.baseline: Hunters were an enviable profession. Partly because they were guardians who had protected humanity from the Great Cataclysm……but mainly because they made a lot of money.
hunks.sol: Hunters were the envy of society. Partly because they were the guardians who had protected humanity from the Great Cataclysm… but mainly because they made a lot of money.

hunks.baseline: Even I made over 100 million won a year as a lowest-rank Hunter by working my ass off, so that said it all.
hunks.sol: Even I had earned over 100 million won a year as a bottom-tier Hunter by working my ass off, so that said it all.

hunks.baseline: *The problem was that they spent a lot, too.*
hunks.sol: *The problem was that we spent a lot, too.*

hunks.baseline: Magic Gems went into equipment as a matter of course, so no matter how carefully you considered cost-effectiveness, you couldn’t help but spend a fortune. On top of that, there were regular maintenance costs and repair fees whenever something broke.
hunks.sol: Magic Gems went into equipment as a matter of course, so no matter how carefully you weighed cost against performance, you couldn’t avoid spending a fortune. Then there were the regular maintenance costs and repair bills whenever something broke.

hunks.baseline: The heartbreak was one thing. Your bank balance got ripped apart.
hunks.sol: The heartbreak was one thing. Your bank balance got ripped apart too.

hunks.baseline: In that regard, Team Leader Choi was the best employer ever.
hunks.sol: In that regard, Team Leader Choi was the best employer imaginable.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi came into the changing room pulling a suitcase and called us over.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi entered the changing room, pulling a suitcase behind him, and called us over.

hunks.baseline: “I picked out decent equipment suited to each of your positions. Take one set each.”
hunks.sol: “I picked out some decent equipment suited to each of your positions. Take one set each.”

hunks.baseline: “Of course there is. If you knew what this was, you’d be shocked……”
hunks.sol: “Of course there is. If you knew what this was, you’d be shocked…”

hunks.baseline: He had guessed it exactly.
hunks.sol: Nailed it.

hunks.baseline: “That’s right. A space-expansion suitcase made by K Company. Nicholas, known as the greatest craftsman in North America……”
hunks.sol: “That’s right. A space-expansion suitcase made by K Company. Nicholas, known as the greatest craftsman in North America…”

hunks.baseline: “World-renowned designers also participated……”
hunks.sol: “World-renowned designers also participated…”

hunks.baseline: “This product keeps stored items in optimal condition through proper temperature control and ventilation at all times……”
hunks.sol: “This product keeps stored items in optimal condition through constant temperature control and ventilation…”

hunks.baseline: “It says it’s a Black Drake Leather Set? No, it’s a leather set.”
hunks.sol: “It says it’s a Black Drake Leather Set. I mean, it’s a leather set.”

hunks.baseline: “……Don’t mention it.”
hunks.sol: “…Don’t mention it.”

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi had completely lost the will to fight by then and changed into his equipment without another word. I checked each piece of equipment I was wearing.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi had completely lost the will to fight by then and changed into his equipment without another word. Meanwhile, I checked each piece of equipment I was wearing.

hunks.baseline: An armor set that gave me forty points simply by wearing it, plus a spear that could kill an enemy from massive blood loss with nearly every stab.
hunks.sol: An armor set that gave me forty points simply by wearing it, plus a spear that could make an enemy bleed to death with nearly every stab.

hunks.baseline: “Maybe it’s because it’s designer gear, but it feels different right away.”
hunks.sol: “Maybe it’s because this is high-end gear, but it feels different right away.”

hunks.baseline: I turned my head and saw Im Kkeokjeong hopping up and down in place, his face flushed with excitement.
hunks.sol: I turned and saw Im Kkeokjeong hopping up and down in place, his face flushed with excitement.

hunks.baseline: “It’s incredibly light, and I feel like my body’s faster too. Is it just my imagination?”
hunks.sol: “It’s incredibly light, and I feel faster too. Is it just my imagination?”

hunks.baseline: “It’s fine. Besides……I’m always wearing my equipment.”
hunks.sol: “It’s fine. Besides… I’m always wearing my equipment.”

hunks.baseline: As he spoke, he unbuttoned his suit jacket, revealing bracelets on both wrists and a necklace. They were not ordinary accessories, of course.
hunks.sol: As he spoke, he unbuttoned his suit jacket, revealing bracelets on both wrists and a necklace. They were no ordinary accessories, of course.

hunks.baseline: The necklace was set with a Magic Gem, and the bracelets were etched with strange yet beautiful patterns.
hunks.sol: The necklace was set with a Magic Gem, while the bracelets were engraved with strange yet beautiful patterns.

hunks.baseline: “An artifact?”
hunks.sol: “Artifacts?”

hunks.baseline: “This is more convenient than a staff.”
hunks.sol: “I find these more convenient than a staff.”

hunks.baseline: Butler Kim answered modestly, but it was rare to see a mage dressed so lightly. Most carried at least some light armor or a staff for self-defense to improve their chances of survival.
hunks.sol: Butler Kim answered modestly, but it was rare to see a mage dressed so lightly. Most wore at least some light armor or carried a staff for self-defense to improve their chances of survival.

hunks.baseline: *He’s probably not an ordinary mage.*
hunks.sol: *Then again, he’s probably no ordinary mage.*

hunks.baseline: Everyone deferred to anyone who came out of Ares Guild.
hunks.sol: Anyone from Ares Guild commanded respect.

hunks.baseline: I suddenly found myself curious about Butler Kim’s past, but the question was wiped clean from my mind the next moment.
hunks.sol: I suddenly found myself curious about Butler Kim’s past, but the question vanished from my mind the next moment.

hunks.baseline: It was Miss Song’s voice from outside the changing room. As soon as Team Leader Choi answered, the door opened a crack.
hunks.sol: It was Miss Song’s voice from outside the changing room. As soon as Team Leader Choi answered, the door eased open.

hunks.baseline: Her long, straight hair was tied tightly up, and she was wearing light leather armor. I swallowed a startled breath at the sight of her.
hunks.sol: Her long, straight hair was tied tightly back, and she was wearing light leather armor. I caught my breath at the sight of her.

hunks.baseline: It wasn’t just love making me see her through rose-colored glasses. That was simply the truth. I knew that much just from seeing Im Kkeokjeong, who had treated her like a cute niece until now, swallow hard.
hunks.sol: It wasn’t just love making me see her through rose-colored glasses. It was simply the truth. I could tell from the way even Im Kkeokjeong, who had always treated her like a cute niece, swallowed hard.

hunks.baseline: *I’d better keep an eye on this guy.*
hunks.sol: *I’d better watch this guy.*

hunks.baseline: If even Im Kkeokjeong was reacting like this, the other guys would be no exception. Any young man who seemed even moderately capable would come crawling out by the truckload to hit on her.
hunks.sol: If even Im Kkeokjeong was reacting like this, the other men would be no exception. Any young guy who seemed even moderately capable would come by the truckload to hit on her.

hunks.baseline: *Take Im Changsoo, for example. Im Changsoo, say. Or maybe Im Changsoo……*
hunks.sol: *Take Im Changsoo, for example. Im Changsoo, say. Or maybe Im Changsoo…*

hunks.baseline: His face had been hovering in my mind since earlier.
hunks.sol: His face had kept floating into my mind ever since we met.

hunks.baseline: And yet……why was he bothering me so much? Was it because that punk seemed interested in Miss Song?
hunks.sol: And yet… why was he bothering me so much? Was it because that punk seemed interested in Miss Song?
